title: The flow map of the Fokker-Planck equation does not provide optimal transport
tldr_zh: 严格反例：FP流映射一般非到标准高斯的OT映射，障碍为Hessian非交换项；量化次优度留为开放问题
tldr_en: Rigorous counterexample: the Fokker-Planck flow map is generally not the OT map to the standard Gaussian; obstruction is a Hessian non-commutativity; quantifying the defect left open.
key_numbers: Necessary condition Eq.(9): D^2(log det D^2u - |grad u|^2/2) must commute with D^2u everywhere
Counterexample phi(x1,x2)=x1 x2 + x1^4 in R^2: D^2 phi(0)=[[0,1],[1,0]] and D^2 Delta phi(0)=[[24,0],[0,0]] do not commute
